The head of the Technology Department who secretly controlled the Intelligentsia Guild. She abandoned her fragile human shell, transferring her consciousness into a massive "tree-like brain" just to pry into the secrets of the leviathans.
Yabuli's obsession with power beyond human limits ultimately led to her demise. She was completely assimilated by the Voracity, reverting to an embryonic state and metamorphosing into an unspeakable monster.
